description: List the main worktree and its linked working trees.

categories.name: Options
categories.description: Selected documented options for this command path.

options.detail: Attributes appear on separate lines with a blank line between worktrees. Use -z to handle paths containing newlines.

options.summary: Terminate each porcelain field with NUL
options.detail: Requires --porcelain. Each attribute ends with NUL, with an extra NUL between worktree records. Paths can contain newlines.

options.summary: Show why worktrees are locked or prunable
options.detail: Adds available reasons to the human-readable listing. Use --porcelain separately for machine-readable output.
